passage_text: Olive spots a new little snack on the compost heap. Olive has not seen this snack before. Olive has a sniff of the snack. Olive takes a small bite. The snack smells sharp to Olive. Olive pulls a face. Olive can not say if she likes it. Nell says to just try one more bite. Olive takes one more bite and smiles. Olive grins. The new snack is good after all.
